title: Pedestrian Traffic Light Sequence
source_reference: 规则合成：行人请求触发的交通灯时序
requirements: Implement a traffic-light sequence. When disabled, vehicleRed and pedestrianRed are TRUE and all other lamps are FALSE. When enabled, the normal state is vehicleGreen and pedestrianRed. Latch pedestrianRequest. A latched request starts 3 seconds of vehicleYellow, then 7 seconds of vehicleRed with pedestrianGreen, then returns to the normal state and clears the request. Conflicting green lamps must never be TRUE together.

creation_process: 组合请求锁存、两段固定定时和互斥输出三个规则生成题目
将阶段顺序限定为绿色、黄色、全红行人绿、恢复绿色
human_modifications: 增加禁用安全状态和绿灯互斥要求
review_process: 逐阶段检查灯色无冲突
核对短按请求能够被锁存至完整周期结束

plc_rationale: 交通灯是典型 PLC 定时状态机，可检验请求锁存、阶段迁移与安全互锁。
